push.title: D 2-2 vs unbeatables FC | You: 8.8 (3rd best match performance)
push.body:
Hoo-wee, tuxedo_slide. An 8.8. You played like someone who ate their vegetables.

DID WELL
+ 26 passes, your busiest match yet. You were the heartbeat in the middle.
+ Won 4 of 8 tackles (up from your usual 26%). Clean as a whistle and twice as loud.
+ 8 tackles attempted (up from your usual 4). Defending is a choice, and you chose it every time.
+ 3 key passes (up from your usual 1). Every key pass is a love letter to a teammate.
+ Man of the Match, your 2nd for us. That's an award you earned, not one they handed you.

WORK ON
- 50% passing (13 of 26, down from your usual 58%). Golden rule: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap. Simple as Sunday.

Practice pointer: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.

Lasso-ism of the day: The comeback is always more fun than the setback.

Stay humble, stay hungry. - Coach Lasso

push.title: D 2-2 vs unbeatables FC | You: 8.5 (8th best match performance)
push.body:
Your 8th best match performance, PhogsToffees. An 8.5 against unbeatables FC, and you looked like you belonged.

DID WELL
+ 5 shots at unbeatables FC's goal. The keeper's arms are probably still sore.
+ 5 of 5 shots on target. Smart picks beat big swings.
+ 2 key passes. That's playmaking, plain and simple.
+ A brace against unbeatables FC, your 2nd straight match scoring. You put it where the keeper ain't. That's the whole trick.
+ 0.6 up on your average. Momentum is a wonderful thing.

WORK ON
- Pass accuracy: 80%. Don't settle; 88%+ is there for the taking.
- Goals per shot on target: 40%. You're in the conversation. 60%+ wins the argument.

Lasso-ism of the day: The ball will find the player who wants it. Want it.

Keep raising the bar, I'll keep raising the clipboard. - Coach Lasso

players.name: BellyTb1

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Made chances for your teammates. Unselfish football is the best kind.

weaknesses.detail: Pass accuracy: 59% (bottom quarter of midfielders is 71% or less)
weaknesses.title: Passing accuracy
tips: Play in triangles - one or two touches, then move. The ball should do the running, not you.
Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.
Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one.
weaknesses.coach: The passing got a little loose out there.

weaknesses.detail: Tackles attempted: 2 (bottom quarter of midfielders is 2 or less)
weaknesses.title: Defensive work rate
tips: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.
Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
weaknesses.coach: Need more bite without the ball. Defending is everybody's job.

weaknesses.detail: 0 goals from 4 shots on target - the keeper is getting to them
weaknesses.title: Finishing
tips: We're hitting the target, so now aim for the corners. Keepers love a shot down the middle.
Finesse it to the far post from an angle. One-on-one, go low and hard.
Timed finishing only when you trust it. A clean shot to the corner beats a mistimed rocket.
weaknesses.coach: You're hitting the target, so now let's beat the keeper.

push.title: D 2-2 vs unbeatables FC | You: 7.2 (6th worst match performance)
push.body:
BellyTb1, your 6th worst match performance with a 7.2. Speed bump, not a wall.

DID WELL
+ 1 key pass. Selfless as a church potluck, and twice as filling.
+ PhogsToffees scored and you helped make it happen. Keep feeding those runs.
+ 2-2 with unbeatables FC. We left a little on the table.

WORK ON
- 59% passing (10 of 17, down from your usual 81%). Mind this: Simple and on the ground to the open, facing teammate. Driven and lofted balls are for clear lanes only.
- Only 2 tackles attempted. Quick fix: Know your runner before the cross comes in. A quick look over the shoulder saves a goal.
- 0 goals from 4 on target. Back to basics: Finesse it to the far post from an angle. One-on-one, go low and hard. Slow is smooth, smooth is fast.
- 0.7 below average. The fight's still in you; I saw it.
- Your 6th worst match performance: 7.2. Fixable, every bit of it.

Rep it: Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.

Lasso-ism of the day: Quiet feet, loud heart.

I believe in you. More importantly, I need you to believe in you. - Coach Lasso
